answer: The cheapest defence against cloned agents is making cloning expensive. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a sable the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single garden of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a plume of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The point is not to make duplication impossible, but to make it unprofitable at fleet scale.
